rationale.H001: September labor softness limits soft-landing confidence; August private construction and resilient activity are compatible, but older release vintages overlap existing evidence.
rationale.H002: Low-hire labor risk stays live, but October 7 physical inventories and backward-looking September Fed minutes are not new broad recession evidence.
rationale.H003: FOMC September minutes published October 7 document then-current policy/inflation concerns, not a new realized inflation print. October 7 EIA stocks are mixed: crude draw, gasoline build, low distillates. Public construction did not dominate August gains. No clean causal evidence warrants reweighting.
rationale.H004: Microsoft issuer growth and nominal technology investment provide no new verified broad realized productivity.
